description: Use this tool when the user explicitly asks which sites are accessible or needs to choose among them; it returns the complete list of owned and shared sites. Return the site list without a site dashboard. Use get_site_dashboard separately only when the user also asks for a specific site's identity, location, current overview, energy summary, status, or component health. Do not add a dashboard just because the user asked for all sites. Do not use a site dashboard for raw JSON or site energy history.
name: list_sites
